regression_found_and_fixed.summary: build_train_data never canonicalized persisted template markers to opaque :slot_<ordinal> identities before writing records.jsonl/manifest.json (build_test_data already did this at harnesses/test_data/pipeline.py:119). Every fresh `slm data build-train --source fixture` build therefore persisted named markers (e.g. :auth.title) and unconditionally failed assert_canonical_template_markers at SFT load time (TwoTowerModel.from_records) for all 103/103 records in this fixture corpus.
regression_found_and_fixed.why_undetected_until_now: The prior 2026-07-25 autotrain smoke loop (iter1-iter50, docs/design/autotrain-loop-ledger-20260725.md) reused a single fixture corpus built once at the very start of that session ('artifacts present' skip on data_train/data_test for essentially every iteration), so the broken fresh-build path was never re-exercised in that loop.
regression_found_and_fixed.fix: src/slm_training/harnesses/train_data/pipeline.py: canonicalize the final record set via canonicalize_example_template_markers (+ assert_canonical_template_markers safety net) once, after decontamination/dedup/curation-score gates and before the prompt-contract enrichments (both need canonical-marker-sensitive behavior on either side, verified empirically: canonicalizing earlier collapsed real diversity into generic :slot_N n-grams and cratered RICO fixture yield in testing). Also canonicalize both sides of the --dedup-against cross-corpus fingerprint comparison. staged_materialization.validate_staged_record now validates a locally canonicalized copy without mutating the persisted record. Refreshed the stale dsh0_cap0_fixture.json synthesis-plan pin (v18/v18/v1/openui_ship_gates_v2 -> v21/v21/v4/openui_ship_gates_v4), which had drifted stale across several prior version bumps and masked a second, cascading bug (staged validation's GenerationRequest also required canonical markers) once its own require_executable() version-mismatch crash was fixed. Updated 3 tests whose assertions encoded now-unreachable named-marker/dead-flag behavior.
